title: SZR-030…SZR-200 - Deesys high-sensitivity ZCT (nickel core), 30 mA / 50 mV
range_short_desc: High-sensitivity zero-phase current transformer for directional ground relays
description: Deesys SZR high-sensitivity zero-phase sequence current transformer. A nickel core allows small leakage currents down to about 30 mA to be detected correctly, so it suits static-type directional ground relays where the standard 200 mA / 100 mV ZCT is not sensitive enough. Same round cable-through bodies and window sizes as the DZR series, with a 30 mA / 50 mV output ratio.
